old_caption: The video captures an aerial view of a cityscape enveloped by a thick layer of fog. The scene is dominated by a prominent tower, standing tall amidst the misty landscape. The tower, with its intricate structure, pierces through the clouds, serving as a focal point against the clear blue sky above. Below the tower, the city is densely packed with buildings, their rooftops barely visible through the dense fog. The camera moves slowly forward, revealing more of the city's layout and the tower's dominance over the surrounding area. The fog adds a mystical quality to the scene, obscuring parts of the city and creating a sense of depth and mystery. The overall atmosphere is serene yet dynamic, with the interplay of light and shadow enhancing the visual appeal of the fog-covered urban environment.

caption: The video captures an aerial view of a hillside town blanketed by a thick sea of fog under a clear blue sky, with a tall red-and-white lattice communication tower rising above the cloud layer. The fog continuously swirls and flows across the slope, its billowing edges alternately obscuring and revealing the clustered buildings below. The tower, the rooftops and the horizon stay physically static, so the apparent motion comes from the drifting mist. The camera framing drifts only slightly, gradually moving the small antenna at the far-left horizon out of view while keeping the tower centered. The cloud layer keeps rolling over the hillside, its surface undulating and its gaps widening and closing. Both the rolling fog and the slight camera drift are already in progress and persist through the excerpt rather than resolving into a finished action. The scene holds its calm composition while the mist and viewpoint quietly evolve.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.

or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
